text: However much the Magic works I shall not be a prize-fighter. I shall be a Scientific Discoverer.” “Ax pardon—ax pardon, sir” answered Ben, touching his forehead in salute. “I ought to have seed it wasn’t a jokin’ matter,” but his eyes twinkled and secretly he was immensely pleased. He really did not mind being snubbed since the snubbing meant that the lad was gaining strength and spirit. “LET THEM LAUGH” The secret garden was not the only one Dickon worked in.
